resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (archive.org/details/screenshot-2024-09-24-at-4.25.26-pm) resolves 200, but its own archive.org metadata description reads '广西LNG外输管道复线(北海LNG贵港)' — the Beihai LNG-Guigang branch, a DIFFERENT Guangxi LNG segment, not Baise-Wenshan — so despite the wiki's link-text claiming it shows the Baise-Wenshan groundbreaking, the item's own indexed description doesn't match this segment; not safe to cite. Replaced with three independent, verified sources confirming Status=construction: (1) PipeChina's own newsroom, 2024-08-08, '...正式开工建设' (construction formally launched), a national '14th Five-Year' key energy project; (2) Xinhua's Yunnan bureau, 2024-08-09, independently reporting the same groundbreaking; (3) Yunnan Economic Net's Nov-2025 site-visit report (news.jjrbnet.com), confirming construction still ongoing as of 2025-11-12 — comprehensive progress >50%, welding mileage >263km, expected complete/production-ready 2026. Three independent organizations, spanning 15 months, all agree the line is under construction, not yet operating/shelved/cancelled.

Both sources (verified for token '天然气') describe this unambiguously as a natural-gas pipeline: PipeChina's article states it will add '10亿立方米天然气' (1 bcm/y natural gas) supply to southeastern Yunnan with a designed annual transmission capacity of 10×10^8 m3; the Yunnan Economic Net piece likewise frames it as delivering natural gas to close the region's single-gas-source gap. Fuel=Gas is unambiguous across two independent sources.

current_ref (pipechina.com.cn/front/tzgg/5984.html) is a 2023-06-07 EIA-notice INDEX page that itself states no dates for project origin; its actual attached EIA report PDF (linked from that notice; confirmed live 200, url_verifier's automated substring check misses the token because this is a 23MB PDF and the extractor does not read the full document -- documented false-negative mode in url_verifier.py's own docstring) is the real supporting document. Downloaded and ran pdftotext -layout directly: section 1.3.4 ('评价直接依据') lists as its basis documents (2) '桂气入滇(百色-文山)天然气管道工程可行性研究报告0版(2022年2月20日)' -- the project's Feasibility Study Report, edition 0, dated 2022-02-20 -- and (3) a project name-change notice dated 2022-03-16. Both anchor the project's origin/proposal to 2022, matching GEM's recorded ProposalYear=2022. No second independent document giving a 2022 date was found (the April-2022 CNPC PDF referenced in the wiki citations, a candidate second source, now 504s / is unreachable) -- single-source, but a strong primary EIA filing citing the project's own feasibility-study date.

Same EIA PDF as Proposal (linked from current_ref's notice page, pipechina.com.cn/front/tzgg/5984.html); automated url_verifier substring check misses the token on this 23MB PDF (documented large-PDF extraction limitation), so verified manually with pdftotext -layout: '本工程管道全长约 344.4km，管径 DN500，设计压力为 10MPa' appears repeatedly (18+ occurrences, e.g. lines 38, 1276, 1291, 1344, 2657, 2684, 16004, 16109) -- an exact match to GEM's recorded 344.40 km. NOTE (flagged, not acted on here): every independent source AFTER this EIA/design stage -- PipeChina's 2024-08 newsroom piece, Xinhua Yunnan (2024-08-09), and the 2025-11 Yunnan Economic Net site-visit report -- consistently states 346.8 km instead, suggesting a later route refinement. Per this task's scope (source the RECORDED value, not propose a change), citing the EIA doc that states 344.4 km exactly; the 344.4-vs-346.8 discrepancy is already logged separately by the critical-deep-sweep pass on this row (batches/china-guangxi-gas/staging/deepsweep-pilot/rows/P4723.json) as a spec concern for Update to resolve, not duplicated here as a value change.

Same EIA PDF; same large-PDF url_verifier limitation, manually confirmed via pdftotext -layout: 'DN500' (mm) appears throughout as the design diameter, e.g. '管径 DN500，设计压力为 10MPa' (lines 1276, 1291, 16004, 16109) and '本工程管道沿线...管径为 DN500' (line 1528) -- exact match to GEM's recorded Diameter=500mm.

Searched the full EIA PDF (pdftotext -layout, grep for '2941', '2,941', '29.41', '2.941') and found no document stating exactly RMB 2,941,000,000. The EIA states two different investment figures instead: total investment '工程总投资 29.72×10^8元(不含增值税)' (RMB 2.972bn excl. VAT, of which RMB 137m/1.37x10^8 is environmental investment, 4.61% of total) and separately construction investment '建设投资 28.77×10^8元' (RMB 2.877bn) -- neither matches GEM's recorded 2,941,000,000 (~1% off both). Also checked PipeChina's 2024 newsroom piece and the Nov-2025 Yunnan Economic Net article; neither cites a cost figure at all. Per standing rule against proposing a ref for a value the source doesn't actually support, leaving UNRESOLVED rather than citing a mismatched figure. This ~1% cost discrepancy is also independently flagged by the critical-deep-sweep pass on this row as an open spec concern.

Verified live with url_verifier for both '国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' (exact QCCOwner string) and '2023' -- both present. This 2023-06-07 EIA pre-approval public notice is itself signed by 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司 = National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd, an exact match to GEM's recorded value. The linked EIA PDF (same project filing) independently restates this at section 2.1: '建设单位：国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' and again at its O&M section ('本工程建设完成后由国家管网集团西南管道公司进行管理') -- consistent throughout, but treated as the SAME primary-source filing family (notice + its own attachment), not counted as a second independent source, hence tier=medium rather than high.

Same source as Operator: the notice is signed solely by 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司 = National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd (GEM's Owner1), with the linked EIA PDF's '建设单位' (constructing/owning entity) field naming only this one company -- no joint venture or co-owner is mentioned anywhere in the notice, the EIA report, or either press article reviewed, consistent with Owner1%=100.00%. Single primary-source filing family, tier=medium.
